statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low; U.S. macro and Nvidia catalysts keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. Key checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, cash-open price discovery, and Nvidia's after-hours reporting window and conference call.
headline: Low Tail, elevated catalyst Stress before U.S. data and Nvidia
body: Asian markets remain cautious while Nasdaq futures are only slightly softer. Oil is down more than 2% and the U.S. 10-year yield is near 4.63%. With no verified persistent one-way NQ structure, Tail remains low while Wednesday's macro cluster and Nvidia concentrate event Stress.

lookbackSummary: Published Tail remained low throughout the preceding 24 clock-hours, with one unavailable historical slot. The latest finalized hour was 15% Tail, 57% Stress and normal mode.
outlookSummary: Stress rises into the 12:30 UTC GDP/PCE/durable-goods cluster and U.S. cash open, then again around Nvidia's after-hours reporting window and confirmed 21:00 UTC call. Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way structure, failed retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: Observed Asian trade is cautious, Nasdaq futures are only slightly softer, and oil plus the 10-year yield are lower. No persistent one-way NQ structure is verified.

forecast.analysis: Mid-Asia remains a low-catalyst period. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow or failed retracements.
Late Asia becomes more Europe-sensitive. Cross-asset conflict would favor mixed conditions; sustained directional efficiency would be the Tail trigger.
The Europe transition adds liquidity and can test overnight direction. Tail remains low absent repeated extension after failed pullbacks.
European cash trade can confirm or reject the overnight move. Aligned rates, semiconductors and failed NQ pullbacks would materially raise Tail.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more catalyst-sensitive. Scheduled macro risk lifts Stress, but Tail still requires observed directional persistence.
Macro anticipation can widen ranges before the release. No outcome is known; persistent directional efficiency into the data would be the main Tail escalation signal.
Final pre-release positioning keeps Stress high. Tail remains below WATCH unless one-way extension, shallow pullbacks and cross-asset alignment emerge.
GDP, Personal Income and Outlays, and durable goods are scheduled for 12:30 UTC. WATCH is conditional on persistent post-release repricing rather than volatility alone.
Post-data repricing overlaps the U.S. pre-open. Retracements and cross-asset stabilization would support fast Tail normalization; repeated extension would sustain WATCH.
The cash open can amplify the data impulse. WATCH depends on continuation, session-extreme holding and failed retracements, not on opening volatility by itself.
After the open, two-way rotation would reduce Tail. Repeated extension with semiconductors, yields and breadth aligned would keep WATCH conditions relevant.
Late morning should separate trend from whipsaw. Orderly retracements would support normalization; directional efficiency would keep Tail near WATCH.
By midday the macro impulse may be better digested. Tail falls below WATCH absent continued directional efficiency, while Nvidia keeps Stress elevated.
Early afternoon remains headline-sensitive. Tail requires independent confirmation from price structure and cross-assets before rising materially.
Late-session Nvidia positioning can increase dispersion. Tail remains low unless NQ becomes persistently directional with weak retracement quality.
Power hour raises conditional catalyst sensitivity. WATCH would still require observed extension and failed retracements rather than event proximity alone.
Nvidia's after-hours reporting window is expected around 20:20 UTC, ahead of the confirmed 21:00 UTC call. WATCH remains conditional on persistent repricing.
The 21:00 UTC Nvidia call is the main catalyst. Higher Tail would require sustained NQ extension plus semiconductor confirmation and poor retracement quality.
The first post-call hour can carry a second information wave. Orderly retracements and cross-asset stabilization would support Tail normalization.
Thinner after-hours liquidity can extend interpretation of the Nvidia catalyst. Tail should ease if price discovery becomes two-way rather than one-directional.
Late after-hours Tail falls if the catalyst impulse stabilizes. Stress remains elevated while overnight participants reassess guidance and sector read-through.
The next overnight baseline trends toward normal if no persistent second leg develops. Failed pullbacks would be the main reason to re-escalate Tail.
Early next-Asia conditions should remain calmer if the Nvidia impulse has stabilized. Tail would rise only if a renewed one-way extension emerges.
